hero.title: Study Information Technology in Sweden for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Join Sweden's world-famous tech innovation ecosystem at top-ranked institutes of technology like KTH and Chalmers. Indian students master sustainable enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud architectures, and access post-study residence permits to seek skilled employment.

overview: Sweden is globally celebrated as an innovation and digital technology powerhouse, pioneering sustainable cloud computing, green data centers, and advanced telecommunications. Studying Information Technology in Sweden provides Indian students with direct exposure to an egalitarian, English-speaking professional culture committed to open-source innovation, system resilience, and enterprise digital sustainability.

Leading Swedish institutions—including KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Chalmers University of Technology, and the University of Gothenburg—deliver world-class English-taught Master's degrees in Information Technology, Network Services, and Enterprise Information Systems. Curricula emphasize distributed cloud platforms, enterprise network security, database administration, and digital service management, backed by close partnerships with Sweden's telecommunications and software giants.

Under Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) regulations, international graduates completing an accredited Bachelor's or Master's degree in Sweden can apply for a post-study residence permit for up to 12 months to seek employment or explore business startup opportunities, provided they satisfy self-sufficiency maintenance funds (SEK 10,656/month for applications submitted in 2026) and comprehensive health insurance requirements. Doctoral graduates may be granted up to 18 months for job seeking, or can apply for Swedish permanent residency if they have held doctoral study permits for at least 4 of the past 7 years, completed their PhD, and satisfy statutory employment, income self-sufficiency, and conduct criteria.

universities.desc: KTH offers a premier BSc in Information and Communication Technology. The three-year programme is taught in English and covers programming, electronics, computer science, and AI.

universities.name: University of Gothenburg
universities.desc: The University of Gothenburg offers an International Master's in Information Technology and Learning, focusing on digital technologies, learning environments, and IT implementation.

universities.name: University of Borås
universities.desc: The University of Borås offers specialized master's programmes in Information Systems including AI Management and Data-Driven IT Management.
